description: This file declares the interface for the SAP (SIM Access Profile) service in the Android telephony stack, including function prototypes for registering the service and processing responses.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers the SAP service with the provided callbacks.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes a response message received from the SAP service.

methods.name: processUnsolResponse
methods.description: Processes an unsolicited response message from the SAP service.
